pages.lesson:
LESSON: GUIDED WRITING

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Writing
Topic 3.9: Guided Writing

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Guided Writing. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can handwriting be enhanced?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. write words and phrases from an audio text
2. compose simple texts on various topics legibly and neatly
3. appreciate the role of handwriting in communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GUIDED WRITING
This lesson teaches Guided Writing for Grade 8 MANDARIN.

STUDY STEPS
1. write words and phrases from an audio text
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. compose simple texts on various topics legibly and neatly
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the role of handwriting in communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Guided Writing using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Guided Writing above.
2. Explain Guided Writing to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Guided Writing.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Guided Writing with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Guided Writing important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can handwriting be enhanced?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. write words and phrases from an audio text
2. compose simple texts on various topics legibly and neatly
3. appreciate the role of handwriting in communication

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
